Incoterms 2020

سمسار جمركي

A licensed agent authorised to prepare import/export entries, handle duties, and ensure regulatory compliance on behalf of importer/exporter.

Quick answer: A licensed agent authorised to prepare import/export entries, handle duties, and ensure regulatory compliance on behalf of importer/exporter.

Quick answer

Why it matters

سمسار جمركي matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.
